column7: Ends the login and closes the callback listener when the authorization window passes or the login is cancelled, bounding how long an untrusted browser peer can hold the port and still deliver a code.
HTML-escapes provider-supplied error text on the callback page; a mistake would silently allow reflected script injection into the loopback page.
Builds the scheme://host:port origin that AuthorizationServerMetadata::discover compares the response issuer against; a mistake would silently weaken the RFC 8414 issuer check.
Decides whether a refresh token with an unknown exchange outcome may be sent to the server again, refusing resend unless a settled refresh showed the server keeps tokens.
Debug impl that redacts access_token, refresh_token and client_secret; a mistake would silently leak the stored OAuth credential into logs.
Builds the stored credential and its bounded expires_at (never wrapping) that is_expired relies on; a mistake would silently make an over-long token look valid.
Hashes backend name and resource URL into the file key that keeps each backend's credentials separate; a collision or mistake would silently serve one backend's token to another.
Reads the token only through token_file::read, which refuses files whose mode lets other users read them; bypassing it would silently disable that check.
Removes the stored token file on revocation or logout; a silent failure would leave a credential that should be gone.
Persists the registered client_id first-writer-wins through an O_EXCL 0600 temp and hard_link; a mistake would silently let instances clobber or churn the identity registered with the server.
Replaces an unreadable client_id file under an exclusive lock after re-reading; a mistake would silently remove a valid registration another process wrote.
Builds StdioTaskHost with the tool policy and process nonce plus the store the task surface relies on; a mistake would silently disable policy or nonce enforcement for task workers.
Builds the registry and its AuthState authorizer from default auth config with agent_auth disabled; a mistake would silently admit subscriptions or deliveries under the wrong authorizer.
Refuses a Tasks-surface request that did not declare the Tasks extension with MISSING_REQUIRED_CLIENT_CAPABILITY.
Refuses task creation without an idempotency key and binds the task owner to LOCAL_OPERATOR_PRINCIPAL when admitting a task.
Constructs the worker's caller context asserting Authenticated, the stdio credential principal, LocalTransport kind and trusted flag, which later checks rely on.
Routes tasks/get, update and cancel under the LocalOperator owner with the stored-delivery refusal check and fails closed on any other method.
Refuses tasks/* when no store is open, the request is not modern, or the extension is undeclared, before dispatching.
Refuses a modern tools/call task member whose request did not declare the Tasks extension before building the intent.

Builds the AuthenticatedClient (wildcard backends, LocalTransport principal) that authorize_backend and the managed-vault sole-operator predicate rely on; a mistake would silently widen or drop the stdio identity.
Binds the local-operator relay caller (principal key, session) around every catalogue call via relay::as_caller, so relay scoping keys on the right principal.
Gates prompts/resources calls to backends under the stdio client identity and refuses any method outside the catalogue allowlist with -32601.
Wires the cross-tenant StdioReads read judge into the channel that every bridged client request passes; omitting it would silently disable the MIN.2 judge.
Sets the terminal closed flag that send_request_committing checks to refuse new prompts after EOF; a mistake silently lets frames commit to a dead channel.
Refuses with NoSession on a closed channel or dead writer and withholds any request the reads.request judge rejects, so a withheld prompt reaches no one.
Draws the 32-byte OS-RNG nonce that is the stdio caller's continuation principal; a weak or constant value would let one stdio process redeem another's envelopes.
Forces the once-per-process nonce singleton and is the only path that can bind a caller as stdio; a mistake would re-draw or share the principal.
Installs the notification screen and read scope around the dispatch and routes each notification through queue_notification; a mistake would let notifications skip the judge or the read attribution.

Queues only the frame the read judge StdioReads::notification (src/gateway/outbound/stdio.rs, off the COV.3 paths) returned and warns on a withheld one; a withheld notification has no frame here, so a mistake can drop deliveries but cannot leak one.
Rejects empty or non-array batches as Invalid Request, dispatches each item under tool and mTLS policy with no client channel, and judges every answer individually before it is written.

Writes only frames whose OutboundFrame::stdio_value (src/gateway/outbound/stdio.rs, off the COV.3 paths) is present and closes the queue on a dead sink; a withheld frame carries no value here, so a mistake can stall or drop answers but cannot leak a withheld read.

Fetches the resource's RFC 9728 document whose first authorization server becomes the issuer AuthorizationServerMetadata::discover is then held to; it does not compare the returned resource to the requested one (RFC 9728 3.3), so a mistake silently redirects discovery.
